records.notes: Free primary and specialty healthcare for low-income, uninsured adults living in Loudoun County. records.organization_name: Fairfax County Neighborhood and Community Services
records.location_name: Human Services Mobility Management (TOPS / Fastran) – Pennino Building
records.notes: TTY 711. Program office, not a transit stop. TOPS: subsidized transportation funds on a debit card (each subsidy $100 in benefits for $20) usable with taxicabs, Uber/Lyft, bus and rail via SmarTrip, Capital BikeShare; in-person payments by appointment at the Pennino Building. Fastran (https://www.fairfaxcounty.gov/transportation/fastran; contact block lists 703-222-9764, Mon-Fri 8 AM-4:30 PM): specialized transportation for residents of Fairfax County and the Cities of Fairfax and Falls Church participating in human services programs (critical medical care such as dialysis/chemotherapy on a space-available basis, adult day health care, CSB programs, senior centers – arranged through centers only, senior residences, therapeutic recreation); riders must be certified by a program/agency; sliding-scale fees may apply. Fastran cancellation line 703-324-7068.
records.raw_hours_text: In Person (by appointment only) at the Pennino Building, Monday - Friday, 8 AM to 4:30 PM. (Fastran contact block: Hours: 8 AM - 4:30 PM, Monday - Friday)
records.raw_eligibility_text: Eligibility: Must be a resident of Fairfax County, the City of Fairfax or the City of Falls Church, and meet one of the following criteria: 50 years of age or older, with an annual income of $50,000 or less per individual. Registered user of MetroAccess. Recipient of Supplemental Security Income (SSI) or Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI). Annual income that meets the 225% federal poverty levels by household size.

eligibility.details: Resident of Fairfax County, the City of Fairfax or the City of Falls Church.
TOPS: one of – age 50+ with income $50,000 or less; MetroAccess user; SSI/SSDI recipient; income within 225% FPL. Fastran: certified by a participating human services program.
In-person visits by appointment only (703-222-9764).

services.description: TOPS subsidized transportation debit card and Fastran specialized human-services transportation (medical, senior center, adult day health care, CSB).

records.notes: Non-food services only (Free Food Markets are covered by the food layer). Connects clients with rent and utility funds; free budgeting/financial workshops with Britepaths in English and Spanish (also https://www.wfcmva.org/our-services). Partner services requested via clientservices@wfcmva.org: Shepherd's Center transportation for clients 50+ to WFCM or medical/dental/therapy; CUMC GRACE Ministries clothing & household items (second Saturday monthly); Women Giving Back free clothing for women and small children; Greater DC Diaper Bank; St. Vincent de Paul (St. Timothy's) limited financial aid. Appointments scheduled by phone in English or Spanish; certification by phone in English, Korean or Spanish.
